page.layout: One text block. Full-width heading at top (title, dedication lines, centred). Below it, a woodcut initial N at left with the body text beside it in a single column. Catchword "ita" at right and gathering signature at left below the last line.

main_text.head: FLORENTISS. BER-[?]NATVM REIP. CONSVL. CAETERISQ'VE ORDINIS SENA-TORII VIRIS AMPLISSIMIS, Dominis suis plurimùm ob-seruandis. S.
main_text.p: NIHIL ufquam esse in rebus humanis literis, doctrinaq; præstantius, uobis, amplissimi uiri, satis superq; perspectum est. Siquidem quae uestra est summa humanitas, in eo genere præstantissimos quosq; uiros patria excussos, aut aliunde pulsos præ caeteris omnibus liberaliter excipitis, honorib. & præmijs ornatis, ac denique in uestro quasi sinu,

page.notes: The woodcut initial N (a framed figure scene) is joined to "IHIL", giving NIHIL. The heading's first line ends in a mark after "BER" that I could not identify with certainty, so it is marked [?]. The signature "a 2" is uncertain because the numeral is hard to read, so it is marked [?]. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout, so the printed "effe" is given as "esse". No page number or running head is printed. No marginal notes are visible.
